subject: Middlesex Fells Habitat Restoration
overview: The Commission approved a restoration project for the Middlesex Fells Reservation and expressed support for holding a conservation restriction on land at the former Malden Hospital site.

items.title: Middlesex Fells Invasive Plant Management
items.summary: Approved a Notice of Intent for the Friends of the Middlesex Fells to manage invasive plant species and restore pollinator habitat at the 90-millimeter meadow. The approval includes conditions requiring state-certified applicators, the use of wetland-safe herbicides, and 48-hour notice for any temporary trail closures.

items.title: Felsmere Heights Conservation Restriction
items.summary: Discussed a proposal for the Commission to serve as the primary holder of a conservation restriction on property at 47 Grover Road, formerly part of the Malden Hospital. The Commission reached a consensus to support the project and will review a formal Community Preservation Act funding application in September.
